title: Context / how the layers are assembled
subtitle: Durable knowledge → selective task input → actual actor delivery → independent proof. These are different boundaries.

nodes.title: Greenfield / decompose
nodes.body:
Vision → users → scope → technical shape
Integrations → risks, each persisted
Architecture / phased plan / backlog
User-reviewed decisions and context

nodes.title: Brownfield / context-creation
nodes.body:
Qualified read-only scout profile first
Six full / affected scoped assignments
Bounded report-only synthesis
Native content + provenance transactions

nodes.title: .codearbiter/ project knowledge
nodes.body:
CONTEXT: purpose, vocabulary, stage and limits
Stack: scoped test/build commands and author mapping
Standards + security: rules with preserved human ownership
Brownfield: five content docs + their v2 provenance pairs
ADRs, boards and greenfield plans retain separate owners

nodes.title: L1 / startup state
nodes.body:
Enabled repo: stage, questions, tasks,
overrides and hygiene briefing
SessionStart carries live state,
not the composed persona

nodes.title: L2 / composed persona
nodes.body:
safety-core + current mode body
Arbiter selects existing route owners
Dedup: session × mode × compaction
Mode tokens are a separate control path

nodes.title: L3 / owner + scope rules
nodes.body:
Read the invoked command/skill body
Scope touch → reference-map docs
Read relevant ADR/deferral bodies
Indexes first; no bulk directory reads

nodes.title: L3a / read-time hints
nodes.body:
A bounded pointer, not a full document
security > ADRs > specs > standards
Freshness and dedup are advisory
Host event surfaces differ

nodes.title: L4 / approved specification
nodes.body:
Stable artifact and criterion IDs
Behavior • boundaries • non-goals
Contracts and accepted intent
Normative change invalidates approval

nodes.title: L5 / exactly bound plan
nodes.body:
Same-format spec binding
Task paths, tests, dependencies
Prerequisites and checkpoint membership
No shadow status ledger
nodes.detail: Keep spec criteria, plan tasks, prerequisites and exact engine-returned IDs. Valid native IDs need not start with SPEC- or PLAN-. A typed exact-permutation record reorder keeps identities/history but is a normative edit that invalidates approval; it does not silently authorize reexecution.

nodes.title: L6 / complete task-context read
nodes.body:
identity → index → outline → scoped read
Follow contextual pages to completion
Retain the final engine context ticket
Exact read alone is context-incomplete
Stale cursor or ticket → read again

nodes.title: Lane-specific execution brief
nodes.body:
Feature: exact spec/plan/task identities
Small feature: confirmed inline criteria
Fix: cited defect + named regression
Test-only: retain the existing caller

nodes.title: Not every lane needs this artifact stack
nodes.body: Fix uses supported bug-origin evidence; refactor uses existing parity obligations. Neither fabricates a feature spec/plan to get context.

nodes.title: A context ticket is neither a model memory nor a signature of semantic truth
nodes.body: Typed engine context tickets bind complete task reads. They do not establish actual actor delivery, semantic truth or fresh runtime evidence.

nodes.title: Author context
nodes.body:
Fresh task obligation + delivered scoped input
Check worktree, source and constraints
TDD retains the original caller’s gates

nodes.title: Reviewer context
nodes.body:
Own fresh packet; never reuse author input
Required refs + independent source checks
Reviewer delivery is separately tracked

nodes.title: Runner + authority producers
nodes.body:
Fresh command result / observed reply
Bound to exact current target
Engine-written receipts, not pasted claims
nodes.detail: Receipts and current source identity are distinct from displayed status and semantic correctness. Current source uses native canonical Unicode hashing for observation binding. Host read-dedup markers are runtime state, not plan-authorized verification inputs; the marker repair must not be generalized into arbitrary .gitignore exclusions.

nodes.title: L7 / acceptance evidence
nodes.body:
task-review → combined quality
accept-scope → current acceptance
Commit and finish query proof again

nodes.title: Legacy v1 heal / native v2 refresh
nodes.body:
v1: conditional staged-source auto-heal
v2: selected owned-field preview + receipt
Identity match is not semantic verification
No raw v2 rebaseline fallback

nodes.title: Follow-up harvest / terminal boundary
nodes.body:
[NEEDS-TRIAGE] → task writer for work
Unresolved decisions → open-questions.md
Interactive: confirm; sprint: permitted SMARTS logging
A task-board item is not a typed plan acceptance.

nodes.title: Retained state / bounded recovery
nodes.body:
Refresh keeps initialization and human history
Recover native operations by the same ID
Committed results are read back, not rewritten
Decisions remain with their actual owner

nodes.title: Select task-relevant context
nodes.body:
Task paths + optional coarse map
Assessed provenance and unknowns
Command cwd + observed verification
Scoped constraints and native instructions
nodes.detail: select_task_context is inert. The caller acquires current inputs and native instruction precedence. Copied upstream rules, source-scoped ADRs and declared commands do not gain authority or current verification from packet inclusion.

nodes.title: Compose for this lane and actor
nodes.body:
Full feature: exact artifact IDs
Small feature: inline mini-spec
Fix / test-only: existing caller
Reviewer: named critical references
nodes.detail: compose_feature_actor_input is named by the current feature/TDD/SDD contracts. compose_fix_or_test_actor_input preserves bug origin and the existing route. prepare_review_input blocks missing critical references before a substantive verdict.

nodes.title: Bound actual actor delivery
nodes.body:
Actor + task + actual worktree
Source / host / instruction epochs
deliver → send bounded child input
observed is reported, not authority
nodes.detail: prepare_actor_delivery binds the selected packet digest, actor/task, actual worktree and observable epochs. The caller sends delivery_text on deliver and retains the counted attempt. A reported host-load-event or child-input-capture is not a native task-admission certificate.

nodes.title: Reselect or stop
nodes.body:
Resume / compaction / scope change
Worktree or evidence epoch change
At most two unobserved deliveries
Same binding still unobserved → block
nodes.detail: Two counted attempts apply to the same actor/task/worktree/epoch/packet binding. Unknown epochs cannot make a saved receipt current. No shared session marker or author receipt substitutes for a reviewer’s input delivery.

edges.label: selected rules + recorded intent inform specification

panels.title: 01  /  PRODUCE DURABLE PROJECT KNOWLEDGE
panels.caption: The durable project store survives a new host, a fresh author context or a compacted conversation.

panels.title: 02  /  RESIDENT STATE + SELECTIVE POLICY
panels.caption: Only the selected mechanism contributes; no universal concatenation of every document is implied.

panels.title: 03  /  BIND APPROVED INTENT TO THE EXACT TASK
panels.caption: The HTML engine controls artifact identity, scope and contextual-read completeness; it is not a new public command.

panels.title: 04  /  SELECT AND DELIVER TO THE ACTOR
panels.caption: Actor-specific delivery boundary: pure selection prepares bounded input; the caller must actually deliver it. Neither step grants authority.

panels.title: 05  /  KEEP ROLE CONTEXTS SEPARATE
panels.caption: Only the bounded result crosses a role boundary. No author’s narrative can stand in for independent proof.

panels.title: 06  /  FEEDBACK INTO DURABLE KNOWLEDGE
panels.caption: Context changes only through its owner. A later read selects what is relevant again.

notes.text: These are parallel context inputs. They are not four mandatory serial workflow steps; explicit scope reads remain the owner’s obligation.
Reviewer charter detail is host-specific: Claude’s authority-reviewer serves frozen typed targets; the specialist fleet is not a substitute for that authority seam.
Outputs feed the next relevant invocation through the project store. No new always-loaded context tool, automatic corpus merge or future dashboard is asserted.
Snapshot boundary: the read-hint approved_spec_index scans *.md. Typed HTML task-context reads use the separate artifact engine path.
Claude/Pi expose read-time notices; Codex lacks a native READ event in the documented host matrix. Do not equate generated surface parity with runtime parity.
New HTML admission is blocked under Pi at this commit. Existing Markdown and inline small-feature lanes are not automatically converted.
No packet invents a feature spec, overrides native instruction precedence, refreshes evidence, or proves the child consumed it.
